volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

outputRange.tooltip: Fit keeps Out inside 0…1 and clips the release undershoot to silence. Raw is the filter, above 1 and below 0. A 0…1 slider at the destination still clamps Raw.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On latches Attack, Decay, Resonance, Impulse, and Amplitude on each rising Trigger. Tracking and ƒ stay live. A rise never resets the envelope level.

tracking.tooltip: How strongly Frequency (or wired ƒ) speeds the envelope. 0 ignores it. 1 at one octave above 440 Hz halves Attack and Decay and doubles the ring. 440 Hz is neutral.

frequency.tooltip: Pitch that Tracking compares against 440 Hz. Wired ƒ replaces this knob.

resonance.tooltip: 0 is a smooth one-pole envelope. 1 is the most bounce. Damping is 4 × 200^(−Resonance).

attack.tooltip: Time constant while Trigger is high. 0 maps to 0.5 ms so a resonant attack still rings instead of snapping.

decay.tooltip: Dominant time constant after Trigger falls. Resonance moves the ring frequency and keeps this decay.

impulse.tooltip: 0 follows the Trigger level. 1 is a ping on each rise, then the envelope decays even while Trigger is held.

amplitude.tooltip: Peak height. Fit scales the filter so this is the highest point. Raw can overshoot it.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

aa.tooltip: Antialiasing. Off is the raw clip. ADAA1 uses the previous sample. ADAA2 uses two previous samples and falls back when the input is flat.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

updateOnTrigger.tooltip: On: Delay/Attack/Decay/Sustain/Release/curves/Loop/Level latch on Gate rise — knob/mod changes wait until the next trigger. Off: params apply live.

attackShape.tooltip: Bipolar segment shape. 0 = linear, + = exponential (fast→slow), − = logarithmic (slow→fast).

releaseShape.tooltip: Bipolar shape for decay and release. 0 = linear, + = exp, − = log.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.
